race.comment: ZIGGY BAMA (1) is a progressive 4yo gelding who has won 2/3 starts to date, too fast over this route last start in similar company, scoring by half a length. Lindsay Smith opts for the claimer to offset the weight rise and he'll take plenty of running down again. OUTER BANKS (5) resumes. He's a lightly raced type who won his maiden fresh last campaign and warrants respect with plenty of upside. SALARIA (9) resumes having gone to the paddock a maiden winner at Pakenham, respecting any market support. KID DYNAMITE (3) resumes. He won first up last time in and was consistent thereafter. Should go well.
